search_text: published ZDI-14-347 ZDI-CAN-2162 (0Day) GoPro HERO 3+ gpExec start Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2014-10-02 CVE-2014-6433 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2014-6433 10.0 ['GoPro'] ['HERO 3+'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of GoPro HERO 3+. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the gpExec component. This component performs insufficient parameter validation on the a1/a2 parameters when the c1/c2 parameters are set to "start". Successful exploitation will allow an attacker to execute an arbitrary file on the target device.
